from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

# Load the presentation
prs = Presentation('/root/Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx')

# Task 1: Fix Dangling Paper Titles in slides 2-5 (indices 1-4)
# The paper titles are in TextBox shapes (Shape 2 in each slide)

for slide_idx in range(1, 5):  # Slides 2-5
    slide = prs.slides[slide_idx]
    
    # The TextBox is typically the last shape (Shape 2)
    textbox_shape = slide.shapes[2]
    
    if textbox_shape.has_text_frame:
        text_frame = textbox_shape.text_frame
        
        # Modify text formatting
        for paragraph in text_frame.paragraphs:
            for run in paragraph.runs:
                # Change font type to Arial
                run.font.name = 'Arial'
                # Set font size to 16
                run.font.size = Pt(16)
                # Set font color to #989596
                run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x98, 0x95, 0x96)
                # Remove bold formatting
                run.font.bold = False
        
        # Adjust box width and reposition
        # Get the text to determine required width
        text = textbox_shape.text
        
        # Set a reasonable width for single-line display (approximately)
        textbox_shape.width = Inches(6.5)
        textbox_shape.height = Inches(0.5)
        
        # Reposition to bottom center of slide
        # Standard slide width is 10 inches, so center would be at 5 inches
        # Position at bottom with some margin from bottom
        slide_height = prs.slide_height
        slide_width = prs.slide_width
        
        # Center horizontally
        textbox_shape.left = int((slide_width - textbox_shape.width) / 2)
        # Position near bottom (with margin)
        textbox_shape.top = int(slide_height - Inches(0.8))
        
        print(f"Slide {slide_idx + 1}: Formatted '{text[:50]}...'")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("Task 1 Complete: Fixed paper titles in slides 2-5")

# Task 2: Create Reference Slide
# List of unique papers
unique_papers = [
    "Foam-Agent: Towards Automated Intelligent CFD Workflows",
    "ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models",
    "Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?",
    "MultiAgentBench: Evaluating the Collaboration and Competition of LLM agents"
]

# Add a new slide at the end (blank layout)
blank_slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # Blank layout
reference_slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_slide_layout)

# Add title textbox
title_left = Inches(0.5)
title_top = Inches(0.5)
title_width = Inches(9)
title_height = Inches(1)
title_box = reference_slide.shapes.add_textbox(title_left, title_top, title_width, title_height)
title_frame = title_box.text_frame
title_frame.word_wrap = True

title_paragraph = title_frame.paragraphs[0]
title_paragraph.text = "Reference"
title_paragraph.font.size = Pt(44)
title_paragraph.font.bold = True
title_paragraph.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)

# Add content textbox with bullet points
content_left = Inches(0.5)
content_top = Inches(1.5)
content_width = Inches(9)
content_height = Inches(5)
content_box = reference_slide.shapes.add_textbox(content_left, content_top, content_width, content_height)
content_frame = content_box.text_frame
content_frame.word_wrap = True

# Add each unique paper as a numbered bullet point
for idx, paper in enumerate(unique_papers, 1):
    if idx == 1:
        # First paragraph already exists
        p = content_frame.paragraphs[0]
    else:
        p = content_frame.add_paragraph()
    
    p.text = paper
    p.level = 0
    p.font.size = Pt(18)
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
    
    # Set numbering format
    from pptx.oxml.xmlchemy import OxmlElement
    p._element.getparent().insert(0, OxmlElement('a:buNone'))
    
    # Add numbering manually with proper format
    p.text = f"{idx}. {paper}"

print("Task 2 Complete: Created Reference slide with numbered bullet points")
print(f"  Added {len(unique_papers)} unique papers")

# Task 3: Save the processed file
output_path = '/root/Awesome-Agent-Papers_processed.pptx'
prs.save(output_path)
print("\n" + "="*60)
print(f"Task 3 Complete: Saved to {output_path}")

EOF
